mapper.update: UPDATE hr_salary s SET base_salary = (SELECT h.base_salary FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id = s.employee_id AND h.effective_date = #{today}), post_allowance = (SELECT h.post_allowance FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id = s.employee_id AND h.effective_date = #{today}), other_allowance = (SELECT h.other_allowance FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id = s.employee_id AND h.effective_date = #{today}), perf_bonus_base = (SELECT h.perf_bonus_base FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id = s.employee_id AND h.effective_date = #{today}), social_base = (SELECT h.social_base FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id = s.employee_id AND h.effective_date = #{today}), housing_base = (SELECT h.housing_base FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id = s.employee_id AND h.effective_date = #{today}), housing_rate = (SELECT h.housing_rate FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id = s.employee_id AND h.effective_date = #{today}), update_time = NOW() WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id = s.employee_id AND h.effective_date = #{today})
